written: 2026-11-04 16:15 CST, before any LeWM S1 recording or training
model: MLX LeWM: ViT-tiny encoder (12x192, 3 heads) on 64x64 frames, patch 8; BN projector 192-2048-192; predictor 6 layers, 16x64 heads, MLP 2048, AdaLN-zero on action blocks; history 3; frameskip 5 (action block = 5 ticks x [vx, wz, 4 head deltas] of cmd_exec = 30-d); loss MSE + 0.09 SIGReg (1024 directions, 17 knots on [0,3]); AdamW 5e-5, wd 1e-3, batch 128, grad clip 1.0, fp32
training_data: train-split episodes of configs train-0000..0269 from index, dagger, dagger2, dagger3, recovery_index and the new noisy-bot recording (episodes/noisy_index.jsonl). Excluded: configs 0270-0299 (held out), all dev/test rooms (p2_dev, p2_shadow_dev, p2_look, m6_clips).
control: random-encoder control: same architecture, encoder + projector frozen at random init (projector BN in eval mode with running stats from 200 warm-up batches), predictor trained with the same loss (MSE only; SIGReg has no trainable target), same steps/batch/seed

check_sets.p2_dev: episodes/p2_dev (80 set_lamp bot demos; instances-dev 0010-0029, others 0000-0019)

untouched: confirmation rooms instances-dev 0030-0049 and others 0020-0039; reserved test rooms

gates.G1_no_collapse: on heldout_train embeddings (eval mode): >= 90% of the 192 dims have std in [0.5, 2]; effective rank (exp of entropy of normalised covariance eigenvalues) >= 100; SIGReg statistic at the final checkpoint below its step-1000 value
gates.G2_prediction: one-block prediction error ratio R = mean||zhat_{t+1}-z_{t+1}||^2 / mean||z_t - z_{t+1}||^2 (copy-last-latent = 1.0) with true-latent history of 3: R <= 0.70 on heldout_train and R <= 0.85 on p2_dev; random-encoder control's R reported
gates.G3_action_ranking: heldout_train windows: true last action block vs 15 blocks drawn from other episodes; pick the candidate whose prediction is nearest the true next latent; top-1 >= 0.50 AND >= 3x the random-encoder control's top-1 (chance 0.0625)
gates.G4_probes: p2_enc_probe protocol (bot fresh lamp sightings in results/m5/bc_index.jsonl episodes, 64 px, standardised features, linear softmax, Adam 1e-2 x 800, L2 1e-3, fit configs 0-199, test 200-299): lamp test accuracy >= 0.90 (P2-A' ckpt_016000: 0.837); AND plate (button) in-view AUC, same protocol and frames (ticks with a confirmed button track: positive if seen this tick), >= P2-A' s0's AUC on the same frames
gates.reported_not_gated: random-encoder probe scores, P2-A' s1 and R3 s1 probe scores, yaw-change probe r (truth-labelled, evaluation only), frameskip-2 ablation if time allows
gates.verdict: S1 passes only if all four gates pass; checkpoint used = final step of the planned schedule (no selection among checkpoints)

amendment_1.change: schedule 20,000 steps (was ~30,000 in the feasibility plan) for both LeWM and the random-encoder control; warm-up 1,000, cosine to 0.1x lr at 20k
amendment_1.reason: measured 2.9 steps/s on real data at load 22-36 (other projects + recorder); 30k steps would not finish inside the owner's 6-hour box after the ~1 h noisy recording. Budget is now ~20k x 128 = 2.56M windows (~1.6 passes over the ~1.6M training start positions).
